The company then issued debentures for 90% of the original issue.
If this is a debenture it will usually pay interest and if a debenture pays interest but no principal the company must declare that in its accounts.
The first 50 to 100 shares will be given to the first 50 to 100 applicants who apply in person for an open-end debenture at a cost of $10.
